newsitem.title: CHINA: U.S. Fed chairman Alan Greenspan in China visit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Fed chairman Alan Greenspan in China visit.

text.p: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan is to make a three-day visit to China this week for talks with China's top finance officials as well as President Jiang Zemin, officials said on Tuesday.
Greenspan was due to arrive in Beijing on Wednesday and would head straight into a meeting with China's economic tsar, Vice Premier Zhu Rongji, U.S. officials said.
He would then hold talks with Dai Xianglong, governor of the central People's Bank of China, which is acting as Greenspan's host on the trip, they said.

On Thursday, Greenspan was due to meet Chen Jinhua, chairman of the State Planning Commission, as well as Finance Minister Liu Zhongli and President and Communist Party leader Jiang Zemin before leaving on Friday for Tokyo, they said.
Chinese central bank officials said the trip was strictly limited to bilateral talks with no media access.
